Question: N-3 (T-FRAME 4): can isPercFrame, framePerc and frameWidth be read back from the TBD, or only the T3D?
Answer: T3D only: the TBD interop has no frame-percentage or frame-width field; in the T3D framePerc and frameWidth read, isPercFrame is unreadable (TAS3D getter fails)
Evidence: T3D window 'Windows: CAL_GLZ_FRAMED f84ffecc-7e72-41cc-8b5c-84d977c00b96 ': isPercFrame Unreadable [COMException: The server threw an exception. (0x80010105 (RPC_E_SERVERFAULT))], framePerc Finite(15.059200299549103), frameWidth Finite(0.052000001072883606)

T3D window 'Windows: CAL_GLZ_UNFRAMED 36799e8c-51f7-4ee8-bb7c-8b9591f5ad0e ': isPercFrame Unreadable [COMException: The server threw an exception. (0x80010105 (RPC_E_SERVERFAULT))], framePerc Zero(0), frameWidth Zero(0)

T3D window 'Windows: CAL_GLZ_FRAMED 646ace97-afe8-4977-a432-73aa8ad4a2d4 ': isPercFrame Unreadable [COMException: The server threw an exception. (0x80010105 (RPC_E_SERVERFAULT))], framePerc Finite(14.999111087675454), frameWidth Finite(0.052000001072883606)
